capabilities: Compile the current note and its linked notes into one document
Recursively copy content from links and embeds on their own line
Replace inline links with their link text
disambiguation: Not for complex compilation workflows; the README points users needing those to kevboh's longform plugin.
extras: Documentation is minimal; behavior is explained with a before/after code example but no settings, limitations, or troubleshooting are described.
motivation: The README says only that the plugin is 'focused on simplicity', implying existing compilation options were too complex.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to combine a set of linked notes into one larger document, resolving embeds and links along the way.

relations.evidence: For more complex compilation scenarios, try kevboh's longform plugin

summary: Compilation plugin that recursively merges linked notes into a single document via a Bake current file command.
